definitions.gloss: convenience store payment; paying bills at a convenience store
definitions.explanation: A payment method where bills, online shopping orders, or other charges are paid in cash at a convenience store counter using a payment slip or barcode.

examples.japanese: コンビニ{払|ばら}いを{選|えら}ぶ。
ネットショッピングの{支払|しはら}いはコンビニ{払|ばら}いにした。
examples.english: I chose convenience store payment for the online shopping purchase.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}{代|だい}をコンビニ{払|ばら}いで{済|す}ませた。
examples.english: I took care of the electricity bill through convenience store payment.

notes:
A uniquely Japanese payment method that allows customers to pay for purchases, utility bills, and other charges at convenience stores. Very common in Japan, where convenience stores (コンビニ) serve as multi-purpose service points. Particularly useful for people without credit cards.

HOW IT WORKS:
When shopping online or receiving a bill, select コンビニ{払|ばら}い as the payment method. You receive a payment slip or barcode (by email or print), take it to any convenience store, and pay in cash at the register.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コンビニ{払|ばら}いを{選|えら}ぶ: to select convenience store payment
- コンビニ{払|ばら}いで{支払|しはら}う: to pay via convenience store payment
- コンビニ{払|ばら}いの{期限|きげん}: payment deadline for convenience store payment

OTHER PAYMENT METHODS:
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}: bank transfer
- クレジットカード{払|ばら}い: credit card payment
- {代金|だいきん}{引換|ひきかえ}: cash on delivery
- {口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ}: automatic bank debit
